about_the_game:
Sinister Remains tells a chilling story born from a curse that has lingered for decades.
What began in the 1980s unfolds through an abandoned town, echoes of the past, and a fragile line between nightmare and reality.

Voice recordings left behind a murder, twisted truths, and fragments of lost lives… With every step, you will confront both the shadows of the past and the darkness within your own mind.
Whispers in haunted corridors, confessions hidden in dusty tapes, and visions lurking between the shadows — each will draw you closer to the truth… or drag you further into despair.

With its oppressive atmosphere, meticulously crafted environments, and ever-escalating tension, Sinister Remains offers players an unforgettable experience in the realm of psychological horror.
Can you escape the shadow of the past, or will you become a part of the curse?

content_descriptors.notes:
Content Warning
Sinister Remains contains disturbing and mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. The game features strong psychological horror elements, an intense atmosphere, and story themes that may challenge the player’s mental well-being. It includes graphic depictions of blood, self-harm and suicide references, violent imagery, and portrayals of traumatic events.

As the narrative delves into dark pasts and psychological breakdowns of its characters, certain players may find the experience distressing. Viewer discretion is strongly advised before playing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: In the shadow of a curse that has endured for decades, explore a town haunted by twisted truths and terrifying events. As you search for the remnants of the past, you’ll uncover the darkness around you and within yourself.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
